name: Delayed comic reaction

shots.title: The Stamp and the Fishbowl
shots.sourceExcerpt:
## INT. RECEPTION - DAY

A receptionist carefully stamps a form. Ivo waits with a fishbowl under his arm.
shots.description: Opening composition: a tight insert of the reception desk from above. The receptionist's hands line up a form and press the stamp down with careful precision. The camera slowly rises and pulls back over her shoulder to reveal Ivo on the other side of the desk, waiting patiently with a fishbowl tucked under his arm. Ending composition: a medium over-the-shoulder shot from behind the receptionist, with Ivo centered beyond the desk and the fishbowl clearly visible at his side.
shots.atmosphere: A quiet, orderly daytime reception area with flat office light and a hushed bureaucratic stillness. The thump of the stamp is the loudest sound in the room.

shots.title: Any Dependants?
shots.description: Opening composition: the reverse angle, a static medium two-shot in profile from the side of the desk. The receptionist is on the left, looking down at the form, and Ivo is on the right holding the fishbowl, which sits just out of her eyeline. Without looking up, she asks her routine question. Ivo answers simply and earnestly. Ending composition: the same profile two-shot, with her pen hovering over the form and Ivo standing perfectly still.
shots.atmosphere: Deadpan routine with a faint undercurrent of comedy.

shots.title: She Notices the Fish
shots.sourceExcerpt: She stamps again, then notices the fish. She stops with the stamp raised. Ivo gives the fish a reassuring nod.
shots.description: Opening composition: a frontal medium close-up of the receptionist from Ivo's side of the desk. She brings the stamp down again, lifts it, and her eyes drift up and to the side toward the fishbowl under Ivo's arm (screen right, off-frame). She freezes mid-motion with the stamp raised in the air. The camera makes a slow, subtle push-in on her stunned face. Ending composition: a close-up of her frozen expression, with the raised stamp at the edge of frame.
shots.atmosphere: Comic suspension; the room seems to hold its breath.
shots.music: None; the silence lingers after the stamp.

shots.title: Reassuring Nod
shots.sourceExcerpt: She stamps again, then notices the fish. She stops with the stamp raised. Ivo gives the fish a reassuring nod.
shots.description: Opening composition: a low, intimate close shot at fishbowl height, framing the fish in the bowl under Ivo's arm in the foreground, with Ivo's face above and slightly behind it. Ivo looks down into the bowl and gives the fish a calm, reassuring nod. Ending composition: Ivo and the fish together in frame, with Ivo's gentle expression held over the bowl.
